scope: local ONNX Runtime CPU CIFAR-10 accuracy

dataset.name: CIFAR-10
dataset.order: official test_batch record order, zero-based indices 0..9999

operations: divide by per-channel float32 standard deviation
preprocessing.randomness: none; shuffle is disabled and all 10,000 records are evaluated in file order

index_convention: All sample indices are zero-based positions in official test_batch order.
